apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Your MES apps and updates, together in one place.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.2.8

Time Punch now displays its transparent abstract person-and-clock icon throughout MES Store, even before installation or when an older Time Punch version is installed. The store no longer shows the old installed icon or a letter placeholder for Time Punch.

Update Time Punch to 1.0.2 to use the transparent icon on the Android launcher as well.

Install over the existing MES Store to preserve settings and downloads. Includes the Android 9 certificate verification fix from 1.2.7. Package IDs and signing keys are unchanged.

apps.name: SignPad
apps.description: Sign bills of lading, scan shipments, and keep warehouse work moving.
apps.releaseNotes:
SignPad 1.6.1

Back from the driver step restores the shipper's handwriting for review or correction. Includes the inspection and loading workflow and signed BOL printing integration.

Install over the existing SignPad app to keep pairing and authorization. MES authorization is required to access company data.

apps.name: Time Punch
apps.description: Employee PIN, punch photos, and clock-in, break, and clock-out actions for MES tablets.
apps.releaseNotes:
Time Punch 1.0.2

Corrected the abstract person-and-clock icon to use a fully transparent background. The person and clock are teal; the surrounding area and the clock interior contain no background fill.

Update MES Store to 1.2.8 for the same icon in the store, including before Time Punch is installed or updated.

Install over the existing Time Punch app to keep your station configuration. The timecard punch workflow is unchanged.
